previous.changeLog:
Battle widget on Alt key — a new peek mode: keep the in-battle overlay hidden and show it
only while you hold Alt (opt-in via the settings panel).
Counted Assistance row — an opt-in third row in the in-battle overlay showing the assistance
damage that counts toward your MoE.
In-battle overlay alignment — the overlay rows now line up with the game's native
efficiency panel instead of sitting slightly high.
Backdrop drift fixed — the row backdrops no longer creep out of alignment with their
text as rows stack.

current.changeLog:
More accurate live MoE % — the in-battle projection now follows a smooth curve fitted to the
real percentile scale, so the live percentage tracks your garage mark percentage far more
closely instead of drifting apart.
Self-calibrating projection — the overlay learns your account's own damage-averaging
behaviour from your battles and tunes the live estimate to it automatically. No setup; it kicks
in after a handful of battles and is remembered per account.
